title: The mixed one look walk reaches the alignment buttons again
goal: One of the scripted walks that checks a mixed text selection stops partway through because the row of text alignment buttons it wants to press has scrolled out of the panel, so nothing is checking that part of the app any more.
notes: Confirmed pre-existing on 2026-09-05: it fails identically on a stashed pre-change build. Fails at step 35 (press): the control "align center" is not in the window; scroll to it with a scrollPanel step first. The panel builds only the rows on screen, so the walk needs a scrollPanel step before that press, or a taller window. Five other walks failed in the same playtest-all run and all five pass on their own, so those are shared-state cascade and this is the only real one.
acceptance: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/mixed-one-look-walk.json passes on its own
It passes twice in a row, so it is not depending on state a previous run left behind
